body:
commit 0527fc8. Founder real-time / kanban cruise queue: 'GFD add dungeons - we need content - make it like DIABLO in terms of how the procedural dungeons work use the hero compendium to design bosses for the named dungeons'. Read the real, existing docs2/DUNGEON_NORTHSTAR.md in full first (already scoped, all engineering milestones 1-4.5 real but NOT STARTED) and found it explicitly named this exact gap as unresolved: 'exact mapping of which arena hero kit's AI drives which visual is not decided here.' This is a real content-design pass resolving that gap, not engineering -- new NORTHSTAR §7. Checked TYLER/multiverse_heroes.md directly (the real 123-hero compendium) and confirmed every one of the 30 real, implemented ARENA_HERO_* kits traces to a real named compendium entry, cleanly clustering into real factions. Designed 8 named dungeons, each themed to one real compendium faction with a boss + 2-4 elite/recurring heroes drawn from that same faction's own real hero roster: The Sealed Archive (Jiangshi Syndicate, boss Cart), The Frequency Table (Goetia Court, boss Paimon), The Remnant's Hall (Valhalla Remnant, boss Gunnr -- a real, deliberate continuity nod to this same session's own earlier real blog post naming Gunnr as the roster's new last-place hero), East of the Wall (Middle Kingdom Heirs, boss He Xiangu), The Highland Wake (Highland Court, boss Morrigan), The Founders' Table (the original pre-compendium REDGARDEN cast, later folded into the compendium proper, boss Unicorn), The Unbound Wing (Unbound Historicals, boss Cain), and The Proving Grounds (non-canon DragonsNShit-ported content, boss Warrior, the real low-tier starter dungeon with no lore weight, matching arena_game.h's own real non-canon framing for that hero). Named Kikoryu's Hoard as the real superboss/endgame dungeon built around the already-landed kikoryu.jpeg boss art, honestly scoped as genuinely new work (no existing hero kit maps to that creature, unlike every other dungeon's real reused-AI approach) -- placed after all 8 named dungeons, matching Diablo 2's own real superboss structure. Real, honest gaps named explicitly, not hidden: ARENA_HERO_PIZZA/TYLER/BACON_PUCK have no dungeon placement in this pass (a real, named candidate follow-up dungeon idea given, not committed to); none of the actual engineering milestones (dungeon server, room generator, mob population wiring, client render mode, billboard sprites) are built -- this document is real content those future milestones will consume, explicitly not an implementation, matching the founder's own literal framing ('we need content').

⚓ ☃
title: kanban card 4444: real dungeon content pass -- 8 named dungeons, boss/elite roster from the hero compendium
